You get a two hundred euro raise. Guess how much more lands in your account. Comment a number.
You earned two thousand five hundred a month. Now it's two thousand seven hundred.
First, your pension takes eighteen euros sixty.
Health, care and unemployment insurance? About twenty four more.
Then income tax grabs another forty one fifty.

text: What's left? About one hundred sixteen euros. Not two hundred.

And no, a raise can't push your whole salary into a higher tax bracket.
Only the extra euros get taxed more. You always keep more than before.

text: So, how close was your guess? Too high or too low?
